scope: Real application, Wild Engine and native HUD. Prescribed paid crop/wall layout, mature crops, tutorial/notification fixtures and QA-prefilled charges. Mouse, keyboard, touch and drag use live handlers; touch and safe insets are emulated in desktop Chrome. No physical mobile device or mobile GPU was tested.
